title: Men's Hockey – Not Weird, Just the Goalie Tee

seo.title: Goalie Shirt: Not Weird, Just the Goalie Tee
seo.description: A funny hockey goalie shirt: a vintage goalie leaning on his net. Unisex 4.2 oz cotton tee, S-4XL, printed to order. Free size exchange.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

A hockey goalie in thick leather pads leans on his net with his glove resting on the red post like it is an old friend, smiling, and the shirt says NOT WEIRD. JUST THE GOALIE. This goalie shirt is for the keeper at the rink, in beer-league night or in the tournament hotel lobby who has heard every joke about goalies.

The print is a 1960s hockey-program scene: a young goalie in a blue sweater, big catching glove and cream leather leg pads, his mask pushed up on his head, leaning on a red-post net with three pucks and ice chips at his skates. NOT WEIRD. sits above in collegiate capitals and JUST THE GOALIE. below in slab letters.

Wear it to the rink, the team bus or the post-game table, or hand it to the hockey goalie in your life, whether they are eight or forty-eight. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, crew neck
  • 100% combed, ring-spun cotton (heather colors contain polyester)
  • Fabric weight: 4.2 oz/yd² — lightweight
  • Pre-shrunk, side-seamed construction, shoulder-to-shoulder taping
  • Sizes S–4XL
  • Colors: Black, Navy, Dark Grey Heather, Heather Forest, Maroon, Natural, Ash, Athletic Heather
  • Blank product sourced from Nicaragua, Honduras, or the US

Questions

What is the Not Weird, Just the Goalie tee?
It is a men's graphic tee from Graphic Tees Co. showing a vintage hockey goalie leaning on his net, lettered NOT WEIRD. JUST THE GOALIE. It is printed on a Bella+Canvas 3001 in 4.2 oz cotton, so it stays light and cool as a base layer or a rink-side tee.

How does the unisex tee fit?
This Graphic Tees Co. tee is a true unisex cut in sizes S through 4XL with a crew neck and side-seamed body. Order your usual size for a classic fit or size up one for a looser look over a base layer. If the size is off, the first exchange is free.

What is it made of and how do I wash it?
The tee is 100% combed, ring-spun cotton, with heather colors blending in some polyester, at a lightweight 4.2 oz. Wash it inside out in cold water with like colors and tumble dry low. That keeps the red, mustard and navy inks crisp after bag-smell laundry cycles.

Is it a good gift for a hockey goalie?
Yes. It suits the goalie in your family, the beer-league keeper and the teammate who talks to the posts. It comes from Graphic Tees Co. at $24.99 in eight colors, sizes S through 4XL, and the free size exchange makes it safe as a birthday, season-end or Christmas gift.

Can I get it by Christmas?
Order by about December 8 and your Graphic Tees Co. hockey tee should arrive before Christmas. Each shirt is printed the day you order it, so ship times vary a little by location. Orders over $45 ship free, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess.

How does it fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in S through 4XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit or size up for a looser one.
